import pptx
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.action import PP_ACTION
import os

def create_interactive_india_ppt(output_path, title, theme_color_hex="1F4E79"):
    presentation = pptx.Presentation()

    # --- Slide 1: Title Slide ---
    slide_layout = presentation.slide_layouts[0]
    slide = presentation.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
    title_placeholder = slide.shapes.title
    title_placeholder.text = title
    
    subtitle_placeholder = slide.placeholders[1]
    subtitle_placeholder.text = "A Dynamic Nation: History, Culture, and Future"

    # Set theme color for title slide elements (simulation)
    # In actual pptx, theme application is complex, simulating via text color
    title_placeholder.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(theme_color_hex)

    # --- Slide 2: Interactive Menu (Simulated) ---
    slide_layout = presentation.slide_layouts[1] # Title and Content
    slide = presentation.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
    slide.shapes.title.text = "Explore India"

    # Simulate interactive buttons using shapes and text
    
    # Button 1: History
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(1), Inches(2), Inches(3), Inches(1))
    shape.text = "History"
    text_frame = shape.text_frame
    text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(18)
    text_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    # Note: True interactivity (hyperlinks between slides) requires specific slide indices which are dynamic.

    # Button 2: Culture
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(5), Inches(2), Inches(3), Inches(1))
    shape.text = "Culture"
    text_frame = shape.text_frame
    text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(18)
    text_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    # Button 3: Geography
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(1), Inches(4), Inches(3), Inches(1))
    shape.text = "Geography"

    # Button 4: Modern Achievements
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(5), Inches(4), Inches(3), Inches(1))
    shape.text = "Modern Achievements"


    # --- Slide 3: History Content ---
    slide_layout = presentation.slide_layouts[1]
    slide = presentation.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
    slide.shapes.title.text = "History"
    body_shape = slide.placeholders[1]
    text_frame = body_shape.text_frame
    text_frame.text = "India's history is a rich tapestry of ancient civilizations, powerful empires (Mauryan, Gupta, Mughal), and a profound struggle for independence, culminating in democracy in 1947."

    # --- Slide 4: Culture Content ---
    slide_layout = presentation.slide_layouts[1]
    slide = presentation.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
    slide.shapes.title.text = "Culture"
    body_shape = slide.placeholders[1]
    text_frame = body_shape.text_frame
    text_frame.text = "A mosaic of diverse cultures, languages, religions, and traditions. Renowned for its classical music, dance, vibrant festivals (Diwali, Holi), and cuisine."

    # --- Slide 5: Modern Achievements ---
    slide_layout = presentation.slide_layouts[1]
    slide = presentation.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
    slide.shapes.title.text = "Modern Achievements"
    body_shape = slide.placeholders[1]
    text_frame = body_shape.text_frame
    text_frame.text = "A global leader in IT and space exploration (ISRO), a rapidly growing economy, and a vibrant hub for innovation and startup ecosystem."


    # Save the presentation
    presentation.save(output_path)
    print(f"Presentation saved to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    desktop_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop"
    output_filename = "India_Interactive_Presentation.pptx"
    output_full_path = os.path.join(desktop_path, output_filename)
    
    create_interactive_india_ppt(output_full_path, "India - A Dynamic Nation", theme_color_hex="0066FF") # Using Tech Innovation primary color
